consequence.statement: This is a new optional feature; existing configurations without CEL expressions continue to work as before.

original.statement: CEL expressions support is added to the readiness evaluation of dependencies for Kustomization and HelmRelease resources.

decision.reason: [ev-8f9ebb6885b8] appears under "Overview of the new features" in the release notes. It describes an added capability: dependency readiness can now be extended with CEL expressions for Kustomization and HelmRelease. Neither that item nor the surrounding section ([ev-522012cd49c1], [ev-3ade4dee13c7] and the other feature items) says that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. So "none" (informational) fits an additive feature, and claiming mandatory work would go beyond the evidence. Confidence is low because the text never says outright that the feature is opt-in.
